ingredients.name: ground coffee, or a coffee and chicory blend

steps.instruction: Add 1 pound of ground coffee to a jar.
Pour 3 1/2 quarts of mineral water over the coffee.
Stir only enough to wet all the grounds, then let it stand overnight.
steps.spoken: Stir only enough to wet all the grounds. Then let the mixture stand for 10 to twelve hours. Overnight is best.

steps.instruction: Line a sieve with cheesecloth and set it over another jar.
Pour the mixture into the sieve so the grounds collect.
Discard the grounds and keep the concentrate in the refrigerator.
steps.spoken: Discard the grounds and keep the coffee concentrate in the refrigerator. It will keep for 2 to 3 weeks.

steps.instruction: To make a cup, mix 1 part concentrate with 2 to 3 parts water.
